answer: In this PoA design, identity verification binds each claimed node to a Wesolowski VDF: it must complete a prescribed chain of modular squarings, with each result determining the next and a succinct proof enabling verification. Simulating multiple clones does not remove the bottleneck: dependent squarings cannot be distributed across GPUs to accelerate one chain, so every identity incurs real elapsed time, whether labeled sparrow, gale, or ocean.
